title: Breaking long URLs
summary: overflow-wrap: anywhere keeps an unbroken URL inside a narrow card.
explanation: Text only wraps at spaces and hyphens. A long URL or identifier has neither, so it runs straight out of its box.
overflow-wrap: anywhere allows a break at any character when a word would otherwise overflow. Normal words are unaffected; only the one that does not fit is split.
white-space: pre-wrap on the address block keeps the line breaks that are written in the text, a handy companion for messages and code.
tryThis: Remove overflow-wrap from .card: the URL escapes the card.
Change it to break-word: it looks the same here; the difference only shows inside flex and grid items.
Remove white-space: pre-wrap from .address: its two lines join into one.
